blocks.text: Padayon Croissant and Coffee has opened its flagship store, bringing a selection of French-inspired croissants, specialty coffee, and other beverages to Cebu’s growing café scene, located at the Ayala Malls Central Bloc in Cebu IT Park. The homegrown brand puts a distinctly Cebuano character behind its café and patisserie concept, drawing inspiration from the Bisaya word “Padayon,” which means to continue or move forward. The venture is led by Bethel San Juan, Don Macchiatos Group of Companies (DMGC) Chief Executive Officer; Ariel Alegado, DMGC Chief Operating Officer; and DMGC President Marc Anthony Abangan.
